page.description: A predictable annual license. Your data stays yours.
page.usageHelp: Certificates and keys are not counted.
page.rule1: Review the customer, validity period and target limit before activation.
page.rule2: Annual licenses keep full operation during the grace period. Evaluation licenses have no grace period.
page.rule3: Lock mode does not delete keys or revoke certificates. In-flight changes finish or roll back safely.
page.lockedText: Inventory, exports, the audit trail and backups remain available. Renew the license to resume changes.
page.graceText: Full operation continues until {{date}}. Then external changes pause; inventory, exports, the audit trail and backups stay available.
page.evaluationText: An evaluation has no grace period: when it ends, external changes pause until a signed license is uploaded.

help.title: How does the hook work?
help.request: For each name, Alice sends the hook an HTTPS POST request with a small JSON body: first with "action": "present" to add the TXT record, and after the check with "action": "cleanup" to remove exactly that record again.
help.body: The body also has the record's name in "fqdn" (for example _acme-challenge.example.com), its "value" and a "ttl". A wildcard name and its base name use the same record name, so keep both values side by side.
help.auth: Every call carries the secret twice: in the header Authorization: Bearer <secret>, and in X-Alice-Signature, an HMAC-SHA256 of the exact body made with the secret, in lowercase hex. Check either one, or both.
help.answer: Answer 200 or 204 when done; any other answer is a refusal. While the record is not visible yet you may answer {"ready": false}: Alice then asks again until you answer {"ready": true}. Repeating a call must do no harm.
help.limits: Alice waits up to {{wait}} seconds after a record is added and asks for at most {{poll}} seconds, {{total}} seconds in all.

scope.hoursHelp: Empty: only when someone starts a scan. At most {{max}} hours (one week).
scope.hoursRange: Enter a whole number of hours from 0 to {{max}}.
scope.useWindow: Only scan during a daily time window
scope.windowHelp: A scan starts only inside the window. When the clocks change for daylight saving time, the window still closes at its local end time, so on that day it can be an hour shorter. With a window, an interval of 24 hours or more counts whole days: 36 hours means every 2 days.
scope.windowRequired: Enter a start and an end time that differ.
scope.windowNeedsSchedule: A time window needs a schedule: enter the hours between scans.
scope.alert: E-mail before certificates found by this scope expire
scope.alertHelp: Uses the expiry thresholds in Settings → Alerts. Only certificates that Alice does not manage are reported.
scope.enabledHelp: A scope that is switched off is not scanned, neither by its schedule nor by hand.
scope.noNetworks: No allowed scan networks are set yet, so this scope cannot be saved. Set them in the discovery settings first.
scope.runningTitle: A scan of this scope is running
scope.runningText: Changing the addresses, ports, server names or exclusions stops it. The results found until then are kept.

preview.title: Size of this scope
preview.waiting: Enter the addresses and ports to see the size.
preview.endpoints_one: One scan tries {{n}} combination of address, port and server name (at most {{max}}).
preview.endpoints_other: One scan tries {{n}} combinations of address, port and server name (at most {{max}}).
preview.excluded_one: {{n}} address is left out by the exclusions.
preview.excluded_other: {{n}} addresses are left out by the exclusions.
preview.builtin: Alice always leaves these out of the ranges here:
preview.stepUp: Confirm it is you to see the size.
preview.tooMany: Too many size checks; the size updates in a minute.

delete.title: Delete {{name}}?
delete.text: Alice stops scanning these addresses. A scan of this scope that is running now is stopped.
delete.results: The places this scope found are removed by the regular cleanup. A certificate that another scope also finds stays in the results.

scans.title: Scans
scans.polling: The newest scans first. This list updates by itself while a scan runs.
scans.startHelp: Alice connects to every address and port of the scope and reads the certificates. It changes nothing on the scanned servers.
scans.noScopeReady: No scope can be scanned now
scans.noScopes: Add a scope on the Scopes tab first.
scans.emptyText: The scans of each scope appear here, started by hand or by the scope's schedule.
scans.countsHelp: Answered: the server completed a TLS handshake. Not answering: it refused the connection, did not answer in time or did not complete a TLS handshake.

directories.none: No directory is set up yet.
directories.max: Alice works with at most 3 directories.
directories.adminNote: SSO users may be Admin (on the Single sign-on tab) applies to directory users too: while it is off, directory users can be at most Operators.
directories.passwordNote: Directory passwords pass through Alice over a verified ldaps:// connection. They are never stored or logged.

presets.label: Fill in typical values
presets.help: A preset fills the attribute and filter fields only. Nothing is saved until you save the directory.

fields.name: Name shown on the sign-in page
fields.addressesHelp: One ldaps:// address per line, at most 3, tried in order. Example: ldaps://dc1.corp.example:636
fields.uniqueIdHelp: A value that never changes for a person: objectGUID in Active Directory, entryUUID in OpenLDAP. It cannot be changed once people have signed in.
fields.bindDnHelp: A read-only account Alice uses to find users and their groups.
fields.bindPasswordStored: A password is stored. Leave the field empty to keep it.
fields.bindPasswordReenter: You changed the addresses, the service account, the unique ID attribute or the certificate authority: enter the service account password again.
fields.groupNameHelp: Leave empty to use the group's DN as the group value.
fields.mfaRequired: Ask for Alice's authenticator code after the directory password

directories.templateRules: Filter rules: {login} and {dn} stand only in a value position, for example (uid={login}). Write a literal brace as \7b or \7d. Control characters are not allowed.
directories.deleteText: The directory, its group mappings and its stored password are removed. A directory that people have signed in through cannot be deleted: switch sign-in through it off instead.
directories.connectionOk: The connection works: Alice could bind as the service account and search the user base DN.
directories.testSignInText: Nobody is signed in and the password is not stored. The result shows the groups the directory returns and the role they give.

result.title: The directory accepted the sign-in.
result.noRole: None: no group is mapped, so this person cannot sign in.

directories.noMappings: No group is mapped yet. Without a mapping nobody can sign in through this directory.
directories.groupHelp: The value exactly as Test sign-in lists it: matched exactly and case-sensitively.
directories.removeMappingText: Members of this group no longer get this role at their next sign-in or confirmation.
